notes: The deep native-quality pass. Your AI answers now stream the way the platform intended: only the live bubble re-renders while GS writes — completed paragraphs and code blocks stay frozen on screen instead of being rebuilt on every flush, so long answers stay smooth from first token to last, and finished code blocks get their full syntax colouring. Every tap in the app now visibly answers your finger — cards, chips, list rows, drawer items, pills and the hold-to-talk orb all press down and spring back with real feedback (previously the press animation was wired to nothing). The Library list is virtualised, so it scrolls just as fast with a thousand saved items as with ten. On iOS the chats, library, archive, shared and search lists now lazily create only what's on screen. Same design, same features — simply built for each platform.
